<thought>Using the observed protonated ion at m/z 114.06808, subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral mass of ~113.0608 Da. The formula C₆H₉O₂ has an exact monoisotopic mass of 113.060255 Da, matching the measured value within experimental error, making it the most plausible molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H9O2</final_answer>
